result.instructions: Tools for Spruce Health, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Spruce Health data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run sprucehealth_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run sprucehealth_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run sprucehealth_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. sprucehealth_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: sprucehealth_get_organization
tools.title: Get the organization
tools.description: Your Spruce organization (id and name). The id is the owner/member id used by other objects. Good first call. GET /organization.

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_members
tools.title: List organization members
tools.description: All members of the organization: teammates (name, email, admin, suspended), teams and the organization itself. Paged with hasMore/paginationToken; totalCount included. GET /organization/members.

page_size.description: Results per page (2-500). Keep it small (e.g. 25-50) for long records: an oversized page is cut, but the Paging part with the cursor always stays whole.

pagination_token.description: The paginationToken from the previous page's reply (when hasMore is true).

tools.name: sprucehealth_get_member
tools.title: Get an organization member
tools.description: One organization member (teammate, team or the organization) by id. GET /organization/members/{memberId}.

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_team_members
tools.title: List a team's members
tools.description: The members of one team (team ids come from sprucehealth_list_members, type 'team'). Paged. GET /teams/{teamId}/members.

page_size.description: Results per page (1-500). Keep it small (e.g. 25-50) for long records: an oversized page is cut, but the Paging part with the cursor always stays whole.

pagination_token.description: The paginationToken from the previous page's reply (when hasMore is true).

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: Contacts of the organization (patients, professionals, clinics): name, date of birth, phones, emails, tags, custom fields, integration links. Paged with hasMore/paginationToken; totalCount included. Use sprucehealth_search_contacts to find someone. GET /contacts.

page_size.description: Results per page (1-500). Keep it small (e.g. 25-50) for long records: an oversized page is cut, but the Paging part with the cursor always stays whole.

pagination_token.description: The paginationToken from the previous page's reply (when hasMore is true).

tools.name: sprucehealth_search_contacts
tools.title: Search contacts
tools.description: Find contacts by free text and/or filters (category, tags, name, phone, email, invite state, created time). Filters combine with AND; values inside one filter match ANY (tags can use all/none). Paged; totalCount with totalCountRelation (eq = exact, gte = lower bound). A read: POST /contacts/search changes nothing.

tags.description: Contact tag text values (the `value` of a tag from sprucehealth_list_contact_tags).

tags_match.description: How the tags combine: any (default), all, or none (exclude).

created_from.description: Only contacts added at or after this time (RFC 3339 with zone).

created_to.description: Only contacts added at or before this time (RFC 3339 with zone).

page_size.description: Results per page (1-500). Keep it small (e.g. 25-50) for long records: an oversized page is cut, but the Paging part with the cursor always stays whole.

pagination_token.description: The paginationToken from the previous page's reply (when hasMore is true).

tools.name: sprucehealth_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: One contact by Spruce contact id (entity_…): demographics, phones, emails, tags, custom and organization fields, integration links. GET /contacts/{contactId}.

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_contact_conversations
tools.title: List a contact's conversations
tools.description: The conversations (secure, SMS/phone, email, fax…) associated with one contact. GET /contacts/{contactId}/conversations.

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_contact_integration_links
tools.title: List a contact's integration links
tools.description: Links between a contact and external systems (Elation, Hint, athena, custom): type, external id, url. GET /contacts/{contactId}/integrationlinks.

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_contact_tags
tools.title: List contact tags
tools.description: All contact tags of the organization. Paged with hasMore/paginationToken; totalCount included. GET /contacts/tags.

page_size.description: Results per page (1-500). Keep it small (e.g. 25-50) for long records: an oversized page is cut, but the Paging part with the cursor always stays whole.

pagination_token.description: The paginationToken from the previous page's reply (when hasMore is true).

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_contact_fields
tools.title: List organization contact fields
tools.description: The organization-wide contact fields shown on every contact. Paged; totalCount included. GET /contacts/fields.

page_size.description: Results per page (1-500). Keep it small (e.g. 25-50) for long records: an oversized page is cut, but the Paging part with the cursor always stays whole.

pagination_token.description: The paginationToken from the previous page's reply (when hasMore is true).

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_conversations
tools.title: List conversations
tools.description: Conversations of the organization (title, type, tags, archived, assignee, participants, last message time), ordered by creation or last message. With start_from, only conversations whose ordering time is at or after it (useful for 'what changed since…'). Eventually consistent. Paged; give start_from OR pagination_token, not both. GET /conversations.

order_by.description: Order by creation time or last message time (default last_message).

start_from.description: Only conversations whose ordering time is at or after this RFC 3339 date-time (with zone).

page_size.description: Results per page (1-200). Keep it small (e.g. 25-50) for long records: an oversized page is cut, but the Paging part with the cursor always stays whole.

pagination_token.description: The paginationToken from the previous page's reply (when hasMore is true).

tools.name: sprucehealth_get_conversation
tools.title: Get a conversation
tools.description: One conversation by id (t_…). GET /conversations/{conversationId}.

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_conversation_items
tools.title: List conversation messages
tools.description: The items (messages, internal notes, calls, voicemails, faxes, attachments with short-lived signed URLs) in one conversation. Order newest_first (default) or oldest_first; start_from = only items created after that time. Paged with hasMore/paginationToken; totalCount is a best-effort count. GET /conversations/{conversationId}/items.

start_from.description: Only items created after this RFC 3339 date-time (with zone).

page_size.description: Results per page (1-200). Keep it small (e.g. 25-50) for long records: an oversized page is cut, but the Paging part with the cursor always stays whole.

pagination_token.description: The paginationToken from the previous page's reply (when hasMore is true).

tools.name: sprucehealth_get_conversation_item
tools.title: Get a conversation message
tools.description: One conversation item (message, note, call, voicemail…) by id (ti_…). GET /conversationItems/{conversationItemId}.

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_read_receipts
tools.title: List a message's read receipts
tools.description: Who has read one conversation item and when they first read it (oldest first). GET /conversationItems/{conversationItemId}/readReceipts.

tools.name: sprucehealth_get_transcription
tools.title: Get a call or voicemail transcription
tools.description: The full transcription text and its summary (if any) for a transcription id (the transcriptionId on a call/voicemail attachment). Status pending/completed/failed/noSpeech. GET /transcriptions/{transcriptionId}.

transcription_id.description: The transcription id (from a conversation item's audio attachment).

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_conversation_tags
